repo.description:
### Impact

App passwords were allowed to bypass password confirmation on sensitive endpoints.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Server is upgraded to 32.0.12, 33.0.6 or 34.0.1
It is recommended that the Nextcloud Enterprise Server is upgraded to 30.0.17.10, 31.0.14.6, 32.0.12, 33.0.6 or 34.0.1

### Workarounds

* No workaround available

### References

<!-- Link to the main/master PR only -->

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3566607)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/61322)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: No password confirmation required when using apptoken on sensitive endpoint
